profile.headline: Game Dev | Game Design | Hardware & Software | Senior Software Engineer (Rust) at Shift5 - Messages are Only Checked Once a Week
profile.summary:
Hello, I'm Alexander Alvarez, 

I have a passion for Computer Graphics, Game Engine Development, Game Development, hardware, and Image Processing.

I'm a hard worker who is always willing to get out of my comfort-zone, learn something new, or even jump head first into a brand new endeavor.

I pride myself with being open minded and being ready to accept and analyze the input or ideas of anyone I'm working with regardless of background, seniority, or situation. I strongly feel everyone can contribute at every level.

Programming Languages: C++, Java, JavaScript, Python, MySQL, CSS
Frameworks, Tools, Libraries: AWS, Eigen, SFML, SDL, QT
General & Administrative: MS Excel, MS PowerPoint, MS Word, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe AfterEffects, Adobe Premier

positions.title: Computer Graphics Engineer
positions.description: Skills: WebGL · TypeScript · WebGPU · Rust (Programming Language) · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD)

positions.title: Backend Software Engineer II
positions.description: Worked on a real-time IOT data pipeline for tracking user analytics on our fleet of industrial grade resin 3D printers.

positions.title: Backend Software Engineer I
positions.description:
Successfully designed and implemented an NFC peripheral management system, streamlining manufacturing processes and increasing efficiency

Developed and implemented a cutting-edge NFC tag printing system for use in manufacturing
Expertly architected and headed the integration of the Polygonica library, resulting in improved performance and functionality

Skilled in handling Linux systems configuration and kernel recompilation, with experience in embedded and industrial devices

Implemented a Wayland server client rendering architecture for currently unreleased devices, contributing to the development of innovative technology

Built and implemented a high-performance serial communications protocol for a proprietary sensor hub utilizing the STM32 microprocessor, resulting in a 62 Hz sample rate.

positions.title: Game Programmer
positions.description:
Skilled in level and mission scripting using Python, with experience in the development of the mobile game "Peek-a-phone"

Collaborated effectively with writers and designers to translate mission designs from written documents to polished and playable products, utilizing Python scripting language to create interactive and engaging levels and missions.

positions.title: Game Designer
positions.description:
Contributed to the development of the underlying framework for future content releases, with a focus on periodic season and content updates.

Led the design of a roguelike dungeon feature for an upcoming update, with a strong emphasis on creating a solid foundation and balancing enemy drops.

Developed a crafting system for the creation and upgrading of player ships, including the design and implementation of various ship components.
positions.insights: Skills: Game Design · Game Development · Unity

positions.description: -Conducted Natural Language Processing (NLP) research in the Martin Lab under the supervision of Dr. Melanie Martin

projects.title: VITAL
projects.description: Internet of Things (IoT) "smart pillbox" that assists elderly patients with taking their medication. Designed and printed 3D model as well as handled the programming of the motor via an Arduino

projects.title: Change
projects.description:
-Programmed a web-baed app using JavaScript and node.js and utilized AWS Cloud 9 for hosting
-Change is a smart donation platform that automatically donates the spare change from the purchases users make to the charities they love. While storing that data so it can later be claimed as a tax deductible and adding gamifying elements to motivate users as they continue to support good causes by showing them what their money is going to
